The agreement establishes an exclusive distribution relationship for the Territory (worldwide excluding Retained Customers) with a five-year initial term plus automatic one-year extensions. Key obligations include Sekisui's exclusive purchasing commitment, Qualigen's supply of all commercial requirements, specific pricing formulas based on Available Margin, and Sekisui's financing payments up to $6.2 million. The contract contains significant exclusivity provisions during an 'Exclusivity Period' leading to a potential acquisition, including a Right of First Refusal for Sekisui. It also includes detailed IP ownership clauses, audit rights, insurance requirements, and liquidated damages for breach of exclusivity.

It contains Sections 13 through 15 (Miscellaneous), Exhibits A-F, and Schedule 2.1. Key obligations extracted include audit rights, assignment restrictions, use of names, press releases, and third-party beneficiary disclaimers. Termination clauses are fully present in Section 14.
